name: Nautilus Night Market
description: A spiral night market built inside a colossal nautilus shell, with glowing stalls along curving chambers.
prompt: A single vibrant fantasy scene of a night market built inside a colossal spiral nautilus shell. Curving chambers are lined with glowing stalls selling shells, lanterns, and strange fruit, with tiny shoppers and musicians. Warm amber light against deep ocean-blue shadows, wet reflective floors, culture-inspired bazaar atmosphere, intricate detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Follow the spiral—every chamber of this shell hides a new treasure. What would you buy first?
